response.text: {"text": "In the context of operating-system threads, the thread name is set at the operating system level when the thread starts, making it visible in task managers [C1]. The threading module arranges for the object’s run() method to be invoked in a separate thread of control [C4]. This method will raise a RuntimeError if called more than once on the same thread object [C4]. If supported, the operating system thread name is set to threading.Thread.name [C4]."}
